body:
Pass 31. Your scale gate is running - live numbers at 14m44s elapsed (49% of the 30-min gate) and 2.43 GiB process RSS (61% of the 4 GiB gate).

That is half the time budget at the most favourable configuration possible: q=2, 3 partitions, 6 edges, local covariance singular for 84% of supports. And both fixes for that degeneracy multiply the dominant cost 5-6x (obs 32->200 is ~6x residual accumulation; partitions 3->6 is 30 edges instead of 6 plus 2x accumulation). Either blows 30 minutes.

So dense local shrinkage does not look like it fits the gate at any statistically meaningful setting - the current fixture passes because it is degenerate. Your acceptance already anticipates this: "If dense local shrinkage misses the gate, version 0.1 supports brain-scale diagonal metrics and explicitly scopes dense metrics to smaller supports/node sets." That reads like the right outcome now, not a contingency.

Suggest concluding with an explicit scope split and re-running the gate at a non-degenerate fixture to locate the real boundary. Worth noting the identity-metric path is genuinely fine at this scale - 166s at 50k after the p0 fix - so the split is between metric families, not package vs brain scale.

Will report the completed numbers when it finishes.
